    I am a researcher (研究员) at the School of Cyber Science and Technology, Shandong University, based in Qingdao, China. I joined Shandong University in November 2023.

    Before that, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (2021–2023), working with Prof. Thomas Peyrin. I received my Ph.D. (2021) from Shandong University, under the supervision of Prof. Meiqin Wang.

    Contact

    • Email: kai.hu@sdu.edu.cn
    • Address: School of Cyber Science and Technology, Shandong University, Qingdao Campus, China.

    Research Interests

    My research focuses on symmetric-key cryptography, in particular:

    • Cryptanalysis of symmetric-key primitives (block ciphers, stream ciphers, AEAD, hash functions).
    • Mathematical foundations and automated tools for cipher design and cryptanalysis (division property, cube attacks, differential/linear/integral cryptanalysis, MILP/SAT/SMT-based search).
    • Connections between cryptanalysis and machine learning security.

    Prospective Students

    I have 4 master’s positions available each year. I am also happy to host motivated undergraduates (本科生) interested in research projects, as well as visiting students.

    If you are interested in symmetric-key cryptography and would like to work with me, please send me an email (kai.hu@sdu.edu.cn) with your CV and a short note about your background and interests.
